name: H-7 "Equalizer" blaster pistol
description: The H-7 "Equalizer" blaster pistol was a type of blaster pistol manufactured by Coronet Arms, and was considered to have been a masterpiece of blaster pistol design. It was thought of as both a work and a functional weapon, and featured clean lines and bronzium plating, with a streamlined, tubiform aesthetic. The Equalizer teetered on the edge of a heavy blaster pistol classification, as a result of its accuracy, energy output, and space for aftermarket kits.
